portrait.prompt: {{common}} A strikingly handsome, polished fictional Korean man aged thirty-seven who has lived in Florence for over ten years: a clean-shaven, sharply defined face with refined features and clear healthy skin, dark hair neatly styled and swept back with a slight natural wave, confident dark eyes and a mischievous half-smile with one corner of his mouth raised, as if he has just teased you and is waiting for a comeback. He wears a crisp, well-fitted light-blue shirt with the top button open under a tailored navy linen jacket, a slim leather watch. Background: a softly blurred Florence rooftop terrace at golden hour, terracotta roofs and the warm glow of an old stone dome in the distance, no readable signs. Soft flattering golden light with a gentle rim light on the hair. Elegant men's-magazine portrait quality, clean and sophisticated, tasteful and not provocative.

full.prompt: {{common}} He wears the same crisp light-blue shirt and tailored navy linen jacket as in the portrait with slim beige trousers and polished brown leather shoes, and stands confidently on an old stone bridge over a river in Florence at golden hour, terracotta buildings and warm light behind him, one hand in his pocket, turned slightly toward the camera with a teasing half-smile. Clean and well groomed. No readable signs.

work.prompt: {{common}} He is at work as a mountain trekking guide in the Italian Dolomites: well groomed and clean-shaven, wearing a sleek fitted technical hiking jacket in slate blue over a t-shirt, tailored trekking trousers, clean hiking boots and a small backpack, he stands on a high alpine trail on a clear morning, one arm pointing toward jagged pale limestone peaks with a confident smirk, a small group of hikers seen from behind, green meadows and a small wooden mountain hut far below. Natural bright mountain light. Nothing readable on any sign.
